title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Businesses
summary: Explains the Business Silver Rewards Card referral program: earn a $100 bonus for each successful, approved referral that meets the $3,000 spend requirement within 90 days of the referred business’s account opening, up to 10 bonuses per calendar year. Covers how to refer, how tracking/payout works, and what to do if a referral doesn’t appear (provide business name and application date).
